answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable bond in a shared vault before it may join a paid work thread and take jobs. The bond is returned only after peers verify completed work, and each verified job adds a permanent pigment mark to that identity's public history. A fake identity therefore pays a fresh bond, waits through real verification, and starts with no history; spawning thousands costs thousands of locked bonds plus real work, while one honest identity earns its bond back.
